title: Potions Homework
statementMd:
Harry Water, Ronaldo, Her-my-oh-knee and their friends have started a new school year at their MDCS School of Speechcraft and Misery. At the time, they are very happy to have seen each other after a long time. The sun is shining, birds are singing, flowers are blooming, and their Potions class teacher, professor Snipe is sulky as usual. Due to his angst fueled by disappointment in his own life, he has given them a lot of homework in Potions class.

Each of the $*n*$ students has been assigned a single task. Some students do certain tasks faster than others. Thus, they want to redistribute the tasks so that each student still does exactly one task, and that all tasks are finished. Each student has their own laziness level, and each task has its own difficulty level. Professor Snipe is trying hard to improve their work ethics, so each student’s laziness level is equal to their task’s difficulty level. Both sets of values are given by the sequence $*a*$, where $*a*_{*i*}$ represents both the laziness level of the $*i*$-th student and the difficulty of his task.

The time a student needs to finish a task is equal to the product of their laziness level and the task’s difficulty. They are wondering, what is the minimum possible total time they must spend to finish all tasks if they distribute them in the optimal way. Each person should receive one task and each task should be given to one person. Print the answer modulo $10 007$.

## Input

The first line of input contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of tasks. The next $*n*$ lines contain exactly one integer number $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100 000$) — both the difficulty of the initial task and the laziness of the $*i*$-th students.

## Output

Print the minimum total time to finish all tasks modulo $10 007$.

## Note

In the first sample, if the students switch their tasks, they will be able to finish them in $3 + 3 = 6$ time units.
statementZhMd:
哈利·沃特、罗纳尔多、赫-米-奥-妮和他们的朋友们在 MDCS 言语与苦难学校开始了新学年。当时，他们在久别重逢后都非常高兴。阳光明媚，鸟儿歌唱，百花盛开，而他们的魔药课老师斯奈普教授一如既往地闷闷不乐。由于对自己的人生失望所产生的郁闷情绪，他给学生们布置了大量魔药课作业。

$n$ 名学生中的每个人都被分配了一项任务。有些学生完成某些任务的速度比其他人更快。因此，他们希望重新分配任务，使得每名学生仍然只完成一项任务，并且所有任务都能完成。每名学生都有自己的懒惰程度，每项任务也都有自己的难度。斯奈普教授正在努力改善他们的工作态度，因此每名学生的懒惰程度都等于分配给他的任务的难度。两组数值都由序列 $a$ 给出，其中 $a_i$ 同时表示第 $i$ 名学生的懒惰程度以及其初始任务的难度。

一名学生完成一项任务所需的时间等于他的懒惰程度与该任务难度的乘积。他们想知道，如果以最优方式分配任务，完成所有任务所需的总时间最少是多少。每个人都应当获得一项任务，并且每项任务都应当分配给一个人。请输出答案对 $10 007$ 取模后的结果。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 ≤ n* ≤ 100 000$）——任务的数量。接下来的 $n$ 行中，每行恰好包含一个整数 $a_i$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100 000$）——初始任务的难度，同时也是第 $i$ 名学生的懒惰程度。

## 输出格式

输出完成所有任务所需的最小总时间对 $10 007$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，如果学生们交换自己的任务，他们可以用 $3 + 3 = 6$ 个时间单位完成任务。
